title: Glood.AI - Shopify AI personalization and recommendation platform
clean_text: Glood.AI is a Shopify-native AI/ML personalization platform offering 12 types of product recommendation widgets including frequently bought together, recently viewed, trending, and bestseller logic, deployable across the product page, cart, mini cart, and checkout. Includes a visual builder for theme-integrated widget customization without code, plus checkout funnels, bundles, and smart popups for AOV growth. Glood also offers separate apps for AI-powered visual search, image and video generation, and inventory demand planning. Targets small to mid-market Shopify and Shopify Plus merchants, with case studies citing up to 145% AOV increases.
